name: Engram
description: Engram is a persistent memory system for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode. Agents save and search memories across sessions through MCP, and Engram Cloud replicates selected projects between machines and team members with a browser dashboard.

notes.text: Sign in to the dashboard with ENGRAM_CLOUD_ADMIN from /opt/engram_data/.env. Clients sync with ENGRAM_CLOUD_TOKEN: engram cloud config --server https://<IP>, then engram cloud enroll <project>.
Clients only send their token over trusted HTTPS. Add /etc/ssl/engram/engram.crt to each client's trust store, or put Engram behind a reverse proxy with a valid certificate.

app_vars.name: var_cloud_token
app_vars.label: Sync Token
app_vars.help: ENGRAM_CLOUD_TOKEN for clients; generated when left empty

app_vars.name: var_allowed_projects
app_vars.label: Allowed Projects
app_vars.help: Comma-separated project names that may sync; * allows all
